designs_by: 'by_at_witness' is the overshoot at the witness point the stand found (the nominal point or a corner), in the quantity's own unit — the worst case may be larger

objective.unit_from: the unit of the prices in the objective (no objective "unit" given)

guaranteed_ends.Mfwd: an end equal to the requirement's bound is what a certificate PROVED (the quantity stays on its side of it); the true extreme may lie further inside

how.Mfwd: ZTL, certificate checked exactly (11 pieces; found by the stand's search, the extreme may lie inside the box)
how.Mrear: ZTL, interval reading of the definition (sound, may be wide)
how.Mside: ZTL, interval reading of the definition (sound, may be wide)

rests_on: ZTL disposition ON CREDIT: the tolerances and ranges are the brick's data (the given quantities and the catalog's datasheet values) — taken as stated, not verified
checker: not run (work mode: ZTL's verdict; --dev runs the independent checker)
checked_by: ZTL (work mode; a refutation's witness recomputed exactly; --dev adds the independent checker on every design)
